Forming Our Future together 
 FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America. 
 
 Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.
 
 
 Shift: 
The regular hours for this position are day shift. 
 
 Job Description: 
 We are seeking a Supply Chain Data Engineer to assist the development of a scalable Planning Analytics and Automation capability that enables data-driven decision-making across a complex, global supply chain. This individual will work across a team to define the strategy, standards, and roadmap for planning analytics, transforming fragmented data environments into integrated, enterprise-level solutions that support SIOP and operational execution.
 
 The role combines fluency in advanced analytics, data engineering, and supply chain processes to translate ambiguous business challenges into scalable analytical frameworks, predictive models, and system-enabled decision support tools.
 
 This individual will help to drive cross-functional alignment, partner with IT to operationalize solutions, and ensure that analytics capabilities are embedded into planning processes and business decisions—not just delivered as standalone outputs.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Data Automation & Process Transformation 
 Assist with transformation of fragmented, manual planning processes into scalable, automated analytics workflows.

 Define and implement scalable data pipelines and data models integrating ERP, planning systems, and external data sources.

 Drive standardization of data flows and reduce dependency on manual data manipulation and spreadsheets.

 Partner with IT to ensure analytics solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture and scalable for global deployment.

 
 Advanced Analytics, Modeling & Decision Support 
 Support design and deploy predictive and prescriptive models to support supply chain decision-making, including Demand forecasting and signal consumption, Inventory optimization and policy setting, Capacity, backlog, and shortage modeling, and Supplier performance and risk analytics.

 Support monthly scenario planning and what-if analysis to support SIOP and executive decision-making.

 Provide structured analysis of trade-offs across supply, demand, cost, and service.

 Translate complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for all stakeholders.

 
 Enterprise Integration & Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Assist cross-functional alignment between Planning, Operations, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, and IT to define requirements and embed analytics into business processes.

 Serve as the bridge between business and technology, ensuring solutions are practical, adopted, and sustained.

 Partner with IT to deploy models, dashboards, and workflows into production environments with enterprise-grade performance and governance.

 Data Governance & Standards Ownership

 Outline data governance for planning analytics, including Data quality standards, Metric definitions, and Reporting consistency across sites.

 Establish frameworks for data validation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

 Ensure alignment with enterprise data platforms, security, and compliance requirements.

 
 Planning Analytics Strategy & Capability Development 
 Propose actions for the development of the Planning Analytics & Automation capability; defining standards, tools, and roadmap to scale analytics across the global supply chain.

 Establish and standardize data models, KPIs, and planning metrics to ensure consistency and comparability across sites and functions.

 Identify and prioritize high-impact use cases to improve planning performance, decision speed, and visibility across SIOP and execution.

 Drive adoption of analytics tools and insights across planning, operations, and leadership teams.

 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience in: Python or R, SQL (data extraction, transformation, performance optimization), and Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools. Experience with Oracle preferred.

 CSCP certification

 Understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes (demand, supply planning, production, inventory, logistics), preferably in a high-mix, low-volume environment.

 Demonstrated ability to design and deploy scalable analytics solutions, not just one-off analyses.

 Ability to translate complex data into business insights and high-level recommendations.

 Experience working with enterprise data environments, including ERP systems and cross-functional datasets.

 Experience with supply chain planning systems (Kinaxis, SAP IBP, or similar).

 Experience with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, Snowflake).

 
 
 Skills: 
Communication, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Data Analysis, Data Reporting, Data Science, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Inventory Logistics, Supply Chain, Supply Chain Inventory Management, Supply Chain Logistics 
 
 Education & Experience: 
No previous professional experience | Required
